compat_page.tone_desc_3: This connection highlights sensitive spots. Balance can grow, but it needs care.
compat_page.tone_desc_4: Some parts flow while others create friction. Honest conversations can improve the match.
compat_page.tone_desc_5: There is common ground here. The right pace and mutual understanding can strengthen it.
compat_page.tone_desc_6: The harmony is starting to show. Managing small differences can deepen the connection.
compat_page.tone_desc_7: You support each other in many areas. Open communication can make this bond steadier.
compat_page.tone_desc_8: The attraction between you looks strong. Emotional openness can make the relationship even richer.
compat_page.tone_desc_9: The rhythm between you feels natural and strong. With care, this can become lasting harmony.

numerology_page.title: Numerology
numerology_page.input_subtitle: Your name and birth date can reveal clues about your character
numerology_page.input_hint: Enter your full name and birth date to see your personal numerology reading.
numerology_page.section_life_path_intro: Shows the direction you naturally move toward in life
numerology_page.section_birthday_intro: Describes a strength you carry from the day you were born
numerology_page.footer_note: The calculation uses Pythagorean numerology. 11, 22, and 33 are considered master numbers, so they are not reduced to a single digit.
numerology_page.desc_1: Starting new things, making decisions, and leading come naturally to you. When you trust your own ideas, your path becomes clearer.
numerology_page.desc_2: Understanding people, softening the mood, and creating balance are your strengths. In relationships, your intuition and calm presence guide you.
numerology_page.desc_3: Expressing yourself, creating, and bringing joy to others come naturally to you. Sharing your feelings instead of hiding them makes you stronger.
numerology_page.desc_4: Planning, putting in effort, and building a solid structure suit you well. When you move patiently, you create lasting results.
numerology_page.desc_5: Change, movement, and new experiences feed you. You need freedom; when you manage it with focus, your life becomes richer.
numerology_page.desc_6: Caring for loved ones, offering support, and creating a safe space are strong in you. Remember not to withhold from yourself the care you give others.
numerology_page.desc_7: Deep thinking, research, and seeing the meaning behind events are your territory. Time alone can help you clear your mind.
numerology_page.desc_8: Setting goals, leading, and creating concrete success are strong in you. When you use your power fairly and with balance, both you and those around you grow.
numerology_page.desc_9: Empathy, a broad perspective, and the desire to help others stand out in you. Sometimes learning to let go is the most important part of moving forward.
numerology_page.desc_11: Your intuition, inspiration, and ability to affect people are strong. When you manage your sensitivity well, you bring hope and awareness to others.
numerology_page.desc_22: You have the potential to turn big ideas into real life. With planning and patience, you can build work that has a lasting impact.
numerology_page.desc_33: Your compassion, desire to teach, and ability to help people feel better are clear. When you protect your own balance first, you can support others in a healthier way.
numerology_page.full_name_hint: As written on your birth certificate
numerology_page.section_destiny_intro: Describes how you show your talents outwardly
numerology_page.section_soul_urge_intro: Shows what you need deep down
numerology_page.section_personality_intro: Describes the energy people notice in you first
numerology_page.section_maturity_intro: Shows the side of you that becomes clearer over time
numerology_page.info_lp_what: This is your main number in numerology. It describes the direction you are drawn toward in life, your core character, and your natural talents.
numerology_page.info_lp_how: Your birth day, month, and year are added separately. Then those results are added together and reduced to a single digit. 11, 22, and 33 are kept.
numerology_page.info_bd_what: Shows a special talent your birth day adds to you. It is a practical clue that supports your Life Path number.
numerology_page.info_bd_how: Only the digits of your birth day are added. For example, if you were born on the 29th, 2 + 9 = 11, and 11 is kept.
numerology_page.info_dst_what: Describes how you use your talents, how you express yourself in the world, and the style you bring to your goals.
numerology_page.info_dst_how: Every letter in your full name is converted to a number using the Pythagorean table. All values are added and reduced to a single digit.
numerology_page.info_su_what: Describes your inner motivation. It shows what truly makes you happy and what you need in relationships and life.
numerology_page.info_su_how: Only the vowels (A, E, I, O, U) in your full name are converted to numbers, added, and simplified.
numerology_page.info_per_what: Describes what people notice about you first. It is about how you are perceived from the outside and the first impression you leave.
numerology_page.info_per_how: Only the consonants in your full name are converted to numbers, added, and reduced to a single digit.
numerology_page.info_mat_what: Describes the side of you that becomes stronger as you get older. It shows the identity you mature into through experience.
numerology_page.info_mat_how: Life Path Number and Destiny Number are added together. The result is reduced to a single digit; 11, 22, and 33 are kept.
